cues.en: Mike: I'd like to say a few quick words about using the code in this course before getting started.
cues.zh: 開始之前，我想先簡單說明這門課的程式碼使用方式。

cues.en: Now, as I wrote in the course landing page, you don't actually need to write a single line of code in order to successfully complete this course.
cues.zh: 就像課程介紹頁寫的，要順利完成這門課，其實一行程式都不必寫。

cues.en: It's totally fine.
cues.zh: 完全沒問題。

cues.en: You can watch the videos and take notes and not do any coding.
cues.zh: 可以只看影片、做筆記，不寫任何程式。

cues.en: But if you are familiar with coding at MATLAB or Python, then I do recommend following along with the code and going through the code challenges and the code exercises.
cues.zh: 但如果熟悉 MATLAB 或 Python 程式設計，我建議跟著寫程式，完成程式挑戰與練習。

cues.en: It's really a great way for you to consolidate all of the knowledge that you're gaining here.
cues.zh: 這真的能很好地鞏固你在這裡學到的所有知識。

cues.en: Okay, so if you want to follow along in MATLAB, you'll need access to MATLAB, of course, but also the Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox.
cues.zh: 如果要用 MATLAB 跟著操作，當然需要 MATLAB，另外還需要 Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox。

cues.en: So to find out if you have these Statistics Toolbox, you can type VER for version, and that's going to dump out all of the toolboxes
cues.zh: 想知道自己有沒有統計工具箱，可以輸入代表版本的 ver，列出所有，

cues.en: that you have available, as well as some other information.
cues.zh: 可用的工具箱，以及其他資訊。

cues.en: So if you see the Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox, you are golden, you're good to go.
cues.zh: 如果看到 Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox，就準備好了，可以開始。

cues.en: If you do not have the Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox, then it is totally fine, you can follow along in Octave.
cues.zh: 如果沒有 Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox，也完全沒關係，可以使用 Octave 跟著操作。

cues.en: I'm gonna show you that in one moment.
cues.zh: 稍後會示範。

cues.en: I just wanna mention briefly that I filmed this course using MATLAB version 2019 B.
cues.zh: 先簡單說明，我錄製這門課時，使用的是 MATLAB 2019b 版本。

cues.en: I'm pretty sure that everything in this course will work with any other version of MATLAB.
cues.zh: 我相當確定，這門課的內容在其他 MATLAB 版本也都能運作。

cues.en: If you have any problems getting my code to run with your MATLAB version, post to the Q and A and I will help you out.
cues.zh: 如果用你的 MATLAB 版本執行程式有問題，請在問與答發文，我會協助。

cues.en: Now, some people have access to MATLAB, but they do not have access to the Statistics Toolbox.
cues.zh: 有些人可以使用 MATLAB，卻沒有統計工具箱。

cues.en: If this is you, if you fall into this category, then I recommend using a free software called Octave.
cues.zh: 如果你屬於這種情況，我建議使用一套叫做 Octave 的免費軟體。

cues.en: It's called GNU Octave.
cues.zh: 它叫做 GNU Octave。

cues.en: You can find it at, don't even worry about the URL, it's probably faster just to Google for Octave, GNU Octave.
cues.zh: 你可以在這裡找到。別擔心網址，直接用 Google 搜尋 Octave、GNU Octave，大概更快。

cues.en: This is a cross platform and free software package.
cues.zh: 這是跨平台的免費軟體套件。

cues.en: It is not exactly like a free version of MATLAB, but it runs nearly all MATLAB commands.
cues.zh: 它不完全等同於免費版 MATLAB，但幾乎能執行所有 MATLAB 命令。

cues.en: So you can run most MATLAB functions inside your Octave installation.
cues.zh: 所以，大部分 MATLAB 函式，都能在安裝的 Octave 裡執行。

cues.en: So you go to this website, you download it, it's pretty easy.
cues.zh: 到這個網站下載就好，很容易。

cues.en: You will need to install the statistics package that's also free.
cues.zh: 需要另外安裝 statistics 套件，它也是免費的。

cues.en: None of this requires any registration or any money or anything.
cues.zh: 這些都不需要註冊、付費，或其他手續。

cues.en: You will need to install the statistics package.
cues.zh: 你需要安裝 statistics 套件。

cues.en: That's a separate thing to do through Octave, and I'm not gonna provide support for that, but you can look online how to install the statistics package in Octave.
cues.zh: 這是在 Octave 裡另外進行的步驟。我不會為這個步驟提供支援，但你可以上網查如何在 Octave 安裝 statistics 套件。

cues.en: It's very easy to do.
cues.zh: 操作很容易。

cues.en: If you are following along in Python, then I wrote all the code for this course using Jupyter IPython notebooks.
cues.zh: 如果使用 Python，我把這門課所有程式都寫成 Jupyter IPython notebook。

cues.en: So they look something like this.
cues.zh: 看起來就像這樣。

cues.en: Now, in theory, you can follow along using any Python IDE you like.
cues.zh: 理論上，可以使用任何喜歡的 Python IDE 跟著操作。

cues.en: So any other environments that you prefer.
cues.zh: 也就是你偏好的其他環境。

cues.en: However, I very strongly encourage you to follow along in Jupiter Notebook, installed through the Anaconda package.
cues.zh: 不過，我強烈建議，使用透過 Anaconda 套件安裝的 Jupyter Notebook。

cues.en: And the benefit of running Jupiter through Anaconda is that everything you need is going to be installed alongside your package.
cues.zh: 透過 Anaconda 執行 Jupyter 的好處，是需要的所有東西，都會隨套件一起安裝。

cues.en: You don't need to worry about any additional dependencies that you will need to install.
cues.zh: 不必擔心還要安裝哪些額外相依套件。

cues.en: So if you do not have the Anaconda package downloaded and installed on your computer, it's very easy to install and it's totally free and it's cross platform.
cues.zh: 所以如果電腦還沒下載、安裝 Anaconda，安裝很容易，完全免費，而且跨平台。

cues.en: So you go to their website, anaconda.com, you go to Products and Individual Edition, and they change their website every now and then,
cues.zh: 到 anaconda.com 網站，選 Products，再選 Individual Edition。他們不時會更改網站，

cues.en: so it might look slightly different from what you see here, but it's gonna be something like this.
cues.zh: 所以畫面可能和這裡稍微不同，但大致就是這樣。

cues.en: So Products, Individual Edition, and scroll down, we wanna go to Download.
cues.zh: 選 Products、Individual Edition，向下捲動，找到 Download。

cues.en: And here, you definitely want to install Python 3, not Python 2.
cues.zh: 這裡一定要安裝 Python 3，不是 Python 2。

cues.en: And almost certainly, you're gonna be using 64-Bit and not 32-Bit.
cues.zh: 而且幾乎可以確定，你要使用的是 64 位元，不是 32 位元。

cues.en: And of course there's a Windows version, a Mac version, and a Linux version.
cues.zh: 當然，有 Windows、Mac 與 Linux 版本。
